whyMinTokensIs70: At 50 the detector reports 9 clones (0.82%) over packages/, at 60 three, at 70 one, and 80 and 100 report the same one — so the 50..70 band is entirely an eight-line `import type { … } from '@oimdb/persist'` run plus a pair of binary searches that differ in `<= 0` against `< 0`. Neither is duplicated logic: every file genuinely needs its imports, and upperBound/lowerBound are the std:: pair whose one attempted merge shipped a wrong ORDER (`r12, r85, joiner` for `r12, joiner, r85`) because `x <= 0` is `x < 1` only for integer comparators and TOIMSlotSorter is any (a, b) => number. 70 is the smallest resolution at which what remains is a body.
whyOIMSingleComputedIsNotScanned: It declares the ten members every object that IS a slot declares — six places under packages/core/src do, in two orders — so the run it shares with facade/entity/OIMSingleEntity.ts is the slot's own shape, not a copied body. A shared base is impossible for the other declarers (OIMSlotOwner and OIMSlotAggregate take their one extends) and would couple a derivation to an entity for ten initialisers. Who may write each member is pinned by packages/core/tests/which-side-of-a-slot-owns-which-part.test.ts, which reads the list off the slot types; that census, not this detector, is what notices a member arriving unowned.
